bindings.why: In the receipt's real selected world, inspect exact ordered Postgres column names/types/nullability, primary key, all secondary index keys/uniqueness and forced RLS, using the restricted Core role. The runner never migrates or seeds.

In the receipt's selected world, Runtime's post-restore public sign-in bearers (person, outsider) each upload a held document through the public /media/files/upload route. Authenticated on the restricted Core role by Access.authenticate, each sees only their own row and anonymous sees neither; every session's direct UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT is refused; the held file is not served by id to the other person; an unsigned upload is refused.

In the receipt's selected world, the person actor uploads a kept image and a held document through the public route. The outsider's session and an anonymous caller read the image row and its exact bytes through /media/files/get, see none of the held document, and have UPDATE and DELETE on the image refused.

near.missing: Runtime direct DML is denied. Component storage/pixel/expiry checks do not establish composed bearer authentication, canonical worldNow, the actual shared transactional outbox or source-correlated lifetime transitions in the same full selected-stack receipt.
